mangrove_close.atExpr: (() => { const cs = game.vegetation.countryside; if (!cs) return null; const t = cs.nearestTree(-873.6, 4825.2, 'mangrove'); return t ? [t.x, t.z, 0.7] : null; })()

mangrove_air.atExpr: (() => { const cs = game.vegetation.countryside; if (!cs) return null; const t = cs.nearestTree(-873.6, 4825.2, 'mangrove'); return t ? [t.x, t.z, 2.2] : null; })()

keys_shore.atExpr: (() => { const C = game.city; let best = null; for (let r = 90; r < 900 && !best; r += 10) for (let k = 0; k < 64; k++) { const a = k / 64 * 6.283, x = -873.6 + Math.cos(a) * r, z = 4825.2 + Math.sin(a) * r; if (!C.isWater(x, z)) continue; let land = 0; for (let q = 0; q < 8; q++) { const b = q / 8 * 6.283; if (!C.isWater(x + Math.cos(b) * 7, z + Math.sin(b) * 7)) land++; } if (land >= 2 && land <= 4) { best = [x + Math.cos(a) * 25, z + Math.sin(a) * 25, a + Math.PI]; break; } } return best; })()

park.atExpr: (() => { const C = game.city; for (let r = 0; r < 3000; r += 40) for (let k = 0; k < Math.max(1, r / 20); k++) { const a = k / Math.max(1, r / 20) * 6.283, x = 407 + Math.cos(a) * r, z = -110 + Math.sin(a) * r; if (C.zoneAt(x, z) === 'park' && C.zoneAt(x + 30, z) === 'park' && C.zoneAt(x - 30, z) === 'park') return [x, z, a]; } return null; })()

place_test.eval: (() => { const V = game.vegetation, x = -873.6 + 18, z = 4825.2 - 10, out = []; for (const [k, dx, dz] of [['poinciana', 0, 0], ['bougainvillea', 4, 3], ['bougainvillea', 5.5, 3.6], ['hibiscus', -3, 4], ['coconut_bent', -6, -4], ['agave', 2, -3], ['potted', 1, 5]]) { try { out.push(V.place(k, x + dx, z + dz).key); } catch (e) { out.push('ERR ' + e.message); } } return out; })()
